english: Take a photo, type a description, or speak to log your meal. My Food AI identifies your food, estimates portions, and records the nutrition consumed. You can edit any entry. The app provides no advice, sets no targets, and makes no health claims.
Nutrition values come from nutrition labels, food reference data, or labelled model estimates.
Only your signed-in account can view your meals in the app. Anyone with a photo's unguessable link can open it, but the app does not publish these links.
